title: Snippets in "{name}"
hint: Stored commands, to be sent via the snippet menu in the terminal. Placeholders: {host}, {user}, {port}, {name}. With a backend, all members see them — passwords do not belong in them.
readOnly: Only whoever manages this workspace may change its snippets: a startup command runs unasked in every colleague's terminal.
commandHint: Several lines are sent one after another, each with Enter.
